item.title: Nibe Festival lands The Minds of 99 by popular demand
item.description: Danish rock band The Minds of 99 will headline the opening day of Nibe Festival on July 1st. According to audience surveys, they are the most requested act. item.title: Denmark to assist France in growing its nuclear asrenal
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has announced that France will increase its nuclear arsenal. This is reported by AFP. Macron stated that Denmark, along with several other European countries, will participate in the French effort, says Reuters. Furthermore, France is leading discussions regarding how other nations might potentially be involved in relevant exercises.

item.title: Denmark enters nuclear agreement with France
item.description: Earlier Monday, French President Emmanuel Macron said that eight countries, including Denmark, had agreed to take part in an “advanced” nuclear deterrence program. In addition to Denmark, the countries are Germany, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece and Sweden.

item.title: Danish Originals, S10E4: Helle Faber
item.description: From Copenhagen, Herning-born documentary producer Helle Faber discusses the secret filming, daring escape and trust behind Oscar-nominated Mr Nobody Against Putin, and her chosen Ragna Braase work at SMK.

item.title: An international artist has organized a free film festival in Copenhagen, where directors will screen their films in their own homes. “It will be about how internationals are welcomed here”
item.description: Being welcomed in Denmark is a complicated concept. It is for this reason that a well-known French artist living in the Danish capital has organized, for the first time, a film festival featuring only international directors. You can join for free, and the movies will be screened directly in the directors’ homes.

item.title: Denmark joins French strategic nuclear cooperation
item.description: Denmark has accepted a French invitation for closer strategic cooperation on a nuclear deterrence program to strengthen Europe’s capabilities. item.title: New agreement reached for half a million employees of the Regions, including nurses
item.description: A new three year collective agreement has been reached for employees in Denmark’s regional sector, including more than 40,000 nurses.
